name: Talos
intro: Talos is new: a hot-rod head with an aluminium diamond-plate front, rivets, a chrome exhaust grille with the power tubes glowing behind it, and flames licking out of both ends. It runs the Dual Rectifier 2025 pack. The four rhythm captures rise in gain, and the fifth was captured with a TS808 in front, so that one sits behind the BOOST button.
notes: Gain blends through captures 1 to 4 (crunch to full rhythm). With BOOST on, it uses the TS808 capture.
Amp only, so it works with your cab section. Accuracy score 0.0096 (median).
Alternative: the Rev F red channel + OD808 capture in your folder (full rig).
